Freego Nova 4 Mid-Drive Electric Dirt Bike

The Freego Nova 4 is a mid-drive electric dirt bike built around the current specification data in Shopify. Key details include 3000 W (Nominal) / 6000 W (Peak) Brushless Mid‑drive Motor, 60V 30Ah (1800Wh) Lithium-ion, 96 × 21700 cells, and Eco Mode: 28 MPH(45 km/h) ; Sport Mode: 45 MPH (72 km/h).

Why Riders Choose the Freego Nova 4

The Freego Nova 4 is designed for riders who want clear power delivery, practical controls, and a chassis matched to off-road and adventure use. Its specification set lists High-strength Steel Pipe, High-Performance Hydraulic Inverted Front Fork and Rear Shock, and Spoke Wheels, Front 19” × 1.6”, Rear 17” × 1.6”.

Key Specifications

Motor Power 3000 W (Nominal) / 6000 W (Peak) Brushless Mid‑drive Motor

Battery 60V 30Ah (1800Wh) Lithium-ion, 96 × 21700 cells

Riding Range 25–50 mi (40–80 km)

Max Torque 280 N·m

Throttle Type Full-twist Throttle

Controller Brushless Motor Controller (80A Nominal / 260A Peak)

Frame High-strength Steel Pipe

Display LCD Color Display

Max Load 264 lb (120 kg)

Net Weight 132 lb (60 kg)

Charging Time 5-7 H

Brake System Hydraulic Disc Brakes (Front & Rear), 4-Piston Calipers with 203 mm Rotors

Suspension High-Performance Hydraulic Inverted Front Fork and Rear Shock

Wheel Type & Size Spoke Wheels, Front 19” × 1.6”, Rear 17” × 1.6”

Tire Type & Size Front 70/100-19, Rear 80/100-17, Tubed, Pneumatic, Puncture-Resistant

Rear Brake Light Yes

Package Size 59” × 11.8” × 32” (150 × 30 × 83 cm)

Suggested Rider Height 5’4”–6’5” (165–195 cm)

Charger Specification 67.2V, 5A

Range Note

Actual riding range can vary with rider weight, speed, terrain, temperature, wind, tire pressure, payload, and riding mode.
